reference_use.conclusion: The snapshot contract (sha256 6e58e5dd…0f4770b) is byte-identical to the workspace Contract.lean and Submission.lean. The Mathlib (25730c7c) and SimonGMT (2b366308) revisions match the project manifest. The pinned Mathlib has no integral-form Gronwall inequality (only Analysis/ODE/Gronwall.lean, which is differential, and DiscreteGronwall.lean), so integral_gronwall is a genuine new obligation. Mathlib supplies the other ingredients: the layer-cake formula (lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt), Tonelli (lintegral_lintegral_swap), measurable_fderiv for arbitrary functions, Real.smoothTransition, improper rpow integrals (integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt) and FTC/monotonicity lemmas. SimonGMT has an earlier Poincaré development (Chapter04/Poincare.lean, PoincareKernel.lean, PoincareTruncation.lean), but it is stated for the strengthened Chapter04.RectifiableVarifold, which the Ch04 README says needs a transport construction, so it is not reused. Its generic kernel and truncation lemmas have different hypotheses, and the children were proved without them. All seven child types elaborate in the exact comparator scope and pass the comparator's statement validator, and a comparator dry run generates the expected challenge and solution modules. All children have machine-checked Lean proofs using only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The selected frozen type compiles from the seven children plus the byte-identical uncle types, with no other sorry.

proof:
Source: parent proof steps 4 and 5 (integration of the pointwise inequality (3.1) over ζ ∈ A_t with Tonelli, then integration over t ∈ (0, ∞) with the layer-cake formula 4.11), stated abstractly: in the parent A = B_{βρ}(ξ), B = B_ρ(ξ), φ(t, x) = ψ'(h(x) − t), G = |∇^M h|, k(x, ζ) = |x − ζ|^{1−n}1_{|x−ζ|≤(1−β)ρ}, κ = α²nω_n/4, L = 2nΓρ.

1. Let f := max(h − ε, 0); f is measurable and nonnegative, and ENNReal.ofReal(h(ζ) − ε) = ENNReal.ofReal(f(ζ)) for every ζ (both sides are 0 when h(ζ) − ε ≤ 0). By the layer-cake formula for μ⌞A:
∫_A ofReal(f) dμ = ∫_{(0,∞)} μ(A ∩ {f > t}) dt.

2. For t > 0, f(ζ) > t ⟺ h(ζ) − ε > t ⟺ t + ε < h(ζ). Hence A ∩ {f > t} = S_t := {ζ ∈ A : t + ε < h(ζ)}, a measurable set.

3. Fix t > 0 and put I_t(ζ) := ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) k(x, ζ) dμ(x); I_t is measurable in ζ (the integrand is jointly measurable and μ⌞B is s-finite). Then
κ μ(S_t) = ∫_{S_t} κ dμ ≤ ∫_{S_t} I_t dμ   [by (iii), which holds μ-a.e. on S_t]
≤ ∫_A I_t dμ   [S_t ⊆ A]
= ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) (∫_A k(x, ζ) dμ(ζ)) dμ(x)   [Tonelli for the s-finite measures μ⌞A, μ⌞B, the integrand being jointly measurable; the ζ-independent factor is pulled out]
≤ ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) L dμ(x) = L ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) dμ(x)   [by (ii) for x ∈ B].

4. t ↦ μ(A ∩ {f > t}) is antitone, hence measurable, and t ↦ ∫_B φ(t, x)G(x) dμ(x) is measurable (Tonelli measurability). Therefore, using steps 1–3,
κ ∫_A ofReal(f) dμ = ∫_{(0,∞)} κ μ(S_t) dt ≤ ∫_{(0,∞)} L ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) dμ(x) dt = L ∫_{(0,∞)} ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) dμ(x) dt.

5. By Tonelli again (Lebesgue measure on (0, ∞) and μ⌞B are s-finite, the integrand is jointly measurable),
∫_{(0,∞)} ∫_B φ(t, x) G(x) dμ(x) dt = ∫_B (∫_{(0,∞)} φ(t, x) dt) G(x) dμ(x) ≤ ∫_B 1 · G(x) dμ(x)
by (i) for x ∈ B.

6. Combining steps 1, 4 and 5: κ ∫_A ofReal(h − ε) dμ ≤ L ∫_B G dμ. (All manipulations are in [0, ∞], so no finiteness of κ, L or of the integrals is needed.) ∎

```lean
  intro X _ μ _ A B h φ G k κ L ε hA hB hh hφ hG hk hi hii hiii
  set f : X → ℝ := fun ζ => max (h ζ - ε) 0 with hf
  have hfmeas : Measurable f := (hh.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const
  have hofReal : ∀ ζ, ENNReal.ofReal (h ζ - ε) = ENNReal.ofReal (f ζ) := fun ζ => by
    show ENNReal.ofReal (h ζ - ε) = ENNReal.ofReal (max (h ζ - ε) 0)
    rcases le_total 0 (h ζ - ε) with hp | hn
    · rw [max_eq_left hp]
    · rw [max_eq_right hn, ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos hn, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
  have hLC := lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt (μ.restrict A)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ζ => (le_max_right _ _ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ f ζ)) hfmeas.aemeasurable
  simp_rw [hofReal]
  rw [hLC]
  have hSmeas : ∀ t : ℝ, MeasurableSet {ζ | t < f ζ} := fun t => measurableSet_lt measurable_const hfmeas
  have hset : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (μ.restrict A) {ζ | t < f ζ} = μ ({ζ | t + ε < h ζ} ∩ A) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply (hSmeas t)]
    congr 1
    ext ζ
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hf, lt_max_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1 | h1, h2⟩
      · exact ⟨by linarith, h2⟩
      · exact absurd h1 (not_lt.2 ht.le)
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inl (by linarith), h2⟩
  have hFmeas : ∀ t : ℝ, Measurable fun ζ => ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * k x ζ ∂μ := by
    intro t
    have : Measurable fun p : X × X => φ t p.2 * G p.2 * k p.2 p.1 :=
      ((hφ.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)).mul (hG.comp measurable_snd)).mul
        (hk.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))
    exact this.lintegral_prod_right'
  have hinner : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      κ * (μ.restrict A) {ζ | t < f ζ} ≤ L * ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x ∂μ := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hset t ht]
    have hSt : MeasurableSet ({ζ | t + ε < h ζ} ∩ A) :=
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hh).inter hA
    calc κ * μ ({ζ | t + ε < h ζ} ∩ A) = ∫⁻ ζ in {ζ | t + ε < h ζ} ∩ A, κ ∂μ := by
          rw [setLIntegral_const, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ ζ in {ζ | t + ε < h ζ} ∩ A, ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * k x ζ ∂μ ∂μ := by
          refine setLIntegral_mono_ae (hFmeas t).aemeasurable ?_
          filter_upwards [hiii t ht] with ζ hζ hmem
          exact hζ hmem.2 hmem.1
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ ζ in A, ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * k x ζ ∂μ ∂μ := lintegral_mono_set Set.inter_subset_right
      _ = ∫⁻ x in B, ∫⁻ ζ in A, φ t x * G x * k x ζ ∂μ ∂μ := by
          rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
          exact (((hφ.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)).mul
            (hG.comp measurable_snd)).mul (hk.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))).aemeasurable
      _ = ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * ∫⁻ ζ in A, k x ζ ∂μ ∂μ := by
          refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
          rw [lintegral_const_mul]
          exact hk.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x * L ∂μ := by
          refine setLIntegral_mono' hB fun x hx => ?_
          gcongr
          exact hii x hx
      _ = L * ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x ∂μ := by
          rw [lintegral_mul_const, mul_comm]
          exact (hφ.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).mul hG
  have hanti : Antitone fun t : ℝ => (μ.restrict A) {ζ | t < f ζ} := by
    intro s t hst
    exact measure_mono fun ζ hζ => lt_of_le_of_lt hst hζ
  have hPmeas : Measurable fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x ∂μ := by
    have : Measurable fun p : ℝ × X => φ p.1 p.2 * G p.2 := hφ.mul (hG.comp measurable_snd)
    exact this.lintegral_prod_right'
  calc κ * ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, (μ.restrict A) {ζ | t < f ζ}
      = ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, κ * (μ.restrict A) {ζ | t < f ζ} := by
        rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hanti.measurable]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, L * ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x ∂μ :=
        setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => hinner t ht
    _ = L * ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ x in B, φ t x * G x ∂μ := by
        rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hPmeas]
    _ = L * ∫⁻ x in B, (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, φ t x * G x) ∂μ := by
        rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
        exact (hφ.mul (hG.comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable
    _ = L * ∫⁻ x in B, (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, φ t x) * G x ∂μ := by
        congr 1
        refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
        rw [lintegral_mul_const]
        exact hφ.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
    _ ≤ L * ∫⁻ x in B, G x ∂μ := by
        gcongr L * ?_
        refine setLIntegral_mono' hB fun x hx => ?_
        calc (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, φ t x) * G x ≤ 1 * G x := by gcongr; exact hi x hx
          _ = G x := one_mul _
```
